typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT PrintLine FROM     [EXTRACT].RegistryMemberPrint WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  JobFileId = ? ORDER BY PrintLineTypeId, SortId',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PrintLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PrintLine)) ~> FlatFileDestination
